integrity: Reproducible, deterministic, standard-library exhaustive enumeration; two independently ordered acyclic matchings, exact integer unimodular certificate, and an original-complex mod-two boundary check. A scientific self-review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The calculation is restricted to the induced-forest degree-two complex of the eighteen-vertex categorical product K2 x K3 x K3; it proves reduced integral homology and six-connectivity, not complete homotopy type, persistent maps, or any all-parameter formula. A bibliographically unindexed equivalent may exist.
title: Three consecutive integral homology degrees in the second forest complex of \(K_2\times K_3\times K_3\)
